parked-reading.title: Example Research Employee saved-research reading for a parked prospect does not meet the reading requirements
parked-reading.impact: A user checking why a prospect was parked, and what would reopen it, cannot rely on the saved-research lookup for that answer.
parked-reading.expected: One concise first response with entity, usable reference URL, saved-research label, assessment date, the parked decision, reason, a key uncertainty and when to reopen, plus the complete assessment (facts, hypotheses, open questions, revisit condition, sources) without manual page commands.
reproduction: In the configured channel, run `/bd research entity:Maple Cooperative`.
Choose **Read full assessment** and read every resulting message or file.
parked-reading.retest: After a fix is deployed, repeat the reproduction, copy every response in full, record the revision, and run `review-workflow --case cases/scott-arbitrum-parked-reading.json --evidence <bundle.json> --state-dir <state> --out <new dir> --retest <finding key>` with an attributed operator assessment.
unknowns: Message IDs, dates, timezone and latency are not captured from copied responses.
No-new-research, database mutation and current-record agreement are not established by copied responses.
